sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Electrophysiology: 'no differences in biophysical properties were found as compared to wild-type channels' (L5). Surface accessibility not explicitly reported in L4/L5 beyond the extracellular tag design.
sites.rationale: L4 names G212 as the insertion point in full-length Kv4.3. Python lookup confirms residue 212 = G and 213 = S, both within extracellular span 204-227, 9 aa from TM1 end (203) and 16 aa from TM2 start (228), satisfying the ≥3 aa TM-distance constraint. The paper's 'S5 end' label is a paper-internal naming convention; the canonical topology places this residue in the S1-S2 loop. L5 confirms preserved biophysical properties. Ranked second because surface detection by immunofluorescence is not explicitly reported for this construct. Full-length Kv4.3 (KCND3); HA tag inserted by conventional PCR after G212, described as 'corresponding to the S5 end' in the source paper (PMC11938557). Position 212 falls within the S1-S2 extracellular loop (topology span 204-227). The paper's 'S5' label likely reflects an internal segment-numbering convention distinct from canonical S1-S6 TM nomenclature; the position is unambiguously extracellular by the authoritative topology. Correct in-frame insertion confirmed by DNA sequencing.

sources.claim: The HA epitope (YPYDVPDYA) was inserted by conventional PCR after glycine 212, corresponding to the S5 end.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Electrophysiology: 'The addition of HA and EGFP tags to Kv4.3 did not affect the functional properties of the channel' (L2). Surface expression confirmed by immunofluorescence in non-permeabilized HeLa cells (L3).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names the junction L216–P217 in the S1-S2 extracellular loop of full-length, membrane-anchored Kv4.3. Python lookup confirms residue 216 = L and 217 = P, both within the extracellular span 204-227, ≥12 aa from either TM boundary. L2 confirms no change in channel functional properties; L3 confirms surface detection by immunofluorescence in non-permeabilized cells. This is the best-evidenced site in the ledger. Full-length Kv4.3 (KCND3) expressed in HeLa cells; HA tag (YPYDVPDYA) inserted by site-directed mutagenesis between L216 and P217 in the S1-S2 extracellular loop (topology-confirmed extracellular span 204-227). Construct used in both WT and disease-mutant backgrounds (T352P, M373I, S390N, ΔF227). Immunofluorescence confirmed plasma membrane trafficking.

sources.claim: An extracellular hemagglutinin tag (HA: YPYDVPDYA) was introduced into the cDNA of pcDNA3.1-Kv4.3 wild type (WT) and mutants (T352P, M373I, S390N and ΔF227) in the extracellular loop between transmembrane domains S1 and S2 (L216-P217) using site-directed mutagenesis via forward primer 5′-CCGGGCAGCAAGGAGCTGTACCCATACGACGTCCCAGACTACGCTCCGTGCGGGGAGCGTAC-3′ and reverse primer 5′-GTACGCTCCCCGCACGGAGCGTAGTCTGGGACGTCGTATGGGTACAGCTCCTTGCTGCCCGG-3′, as described previously for Kv4.2.

literature_notes: L1/L2/L3 and L4/L5 both ground HA-tag insertions in the S1-S2 extracellular loop (topology 204-227) of full-length KCND3/Kv4.3 at two distinct junctions (L216-P217 and after G212), yielding two independent validated sites. L6 (C-terminal mCherry-P2A) is an intracellular fusion (C-terminus 401-655 is cytoplasmic) and does not qualify as a surface tag site. L7 (N-terminal Myc via pcDNA3.1-Myc) and L8 (N-terminal FLAG via pFLAG-CMV-5a) both place tags on the intracellular N-terminus (residues 1-182 are cytoplasmic) and do not qualify. All three are recorded in other_positions. No signal peptide is present in KCND3; the N-terminus is cytoplasmic. The S1-S2 loop contains two conserved cysteines (C207, C218) that likely form a disulfide; both validated insertion sites (G212 and L216) fall between these cysteines but do not disrupt them, consistent with the reported functional preservation.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal Myc tag fused to full-length Kv4.3 via pcDNA3.1-Myc; the KCND3 N-terminus (residues 1-182) is intracellular, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
N-terminal FLAG tag via pFLAG-CMV-5a vector; KCND3 N-terminus is intracellular (residues 1-182), so the FLAG tag is cytoplasmic.
C-terminal mCherry-P2A fusion to full-length Kv4.3; the C-terminus (residues 401-655) is intracellular, so mCherry is cytoplasmic, not extracellular.
